summary.important_warning: R026 is enrolment date; birthDate is a separate supporting clinical date, never R026. This audit distinguishes source fields from computed/read-only outputs, and a prior-visit proposal from a confirmed measurement.

variables.label: N.º ingresos por EPOC entre visitas
